name: GitHub Integration
description: Official GitHub developer integration powered by natural language and AI tool calling. Draft and open technical Issues, inspect repository issues, list your repositories, and search GitHub directly from chat.
author: Chattree Core Team
changelog: 1.1.0: English predetermined UI strings with minimalist Chattree monochrome styling, Unicode \uXXXX decoding, whitespace-tolerant JSON parsing, proper double-JSON escaping, bounded repo/issue parsing (filtering out user URLs), URL-safe query percent-encoding, owner/repo URL normalization, and token-safe AI content guidelines.

tools.description: Official GitHub integration. Output ONLY a single valid JSON object with no extra text. For action='create', provide 'repo' ('owner/repo' if specified), a concise 'title' (max 80 chars), and a well-structured Markdown 'content' (150-350 words: context, technical proposal/steps, and acceptance criteria separated by \n\n) in the user's language.

intentContract.description: Interpret the user's natural-language GitHub request and return ONE valid JSON tool call only. For action='create', generate a clear 'title' and structured Markdown 'content' (150-350 words) in the same language as the user's request.

fields.name: action
fields.description: Action to perform: 'create' (open a new Issue with full Markdown body), 'issues' (list open issues for a repository), 'repos' (list your recent repositories), 'search' (search GitHub repositories), 'set_repo' (save default 'owner/repo'), 'status' (check connection), 'config' (save ghp_/github_pat_ token), 'disconnect' (remove saved token), or 'help' (show usage).

fields.name: repo
fields.description: Target repository in 'owner/repo' format (e.g. 'Ponce5/Chattree'). Include whenever mentioned for 'create', 'issues', or 'set_repo'.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Concise, technical Issue title (max 80 chars). Never copy the raw user prompt verbatim.

fields.name: content
fields.description: Structured Markdown Issue body (required when action='create', 150-350 words). Include context, implementation proposal or repro steps, and acceptance criteria separated by \n\n.

fields.name: query
fields.description: Search query (for action='search'), Personal Access Token ghp_/github_pat_ (for action='config'), or 'owner/repo' (for action='set_repo' if 'repo' is omitted).

examples.input: create an issue in Ponce5/Chattree to add offline sync queue

output.title: Add offline mode with automatic sync queue
output.content:
## Context
Network operations currently require an active connection. Adding a local queue improves reliability on unstable networks.

## Technical Proposal
1. Persist pending mutations locally with status (`pending`, `syncing`, `failed`).
2. Watch connectivity changes and flush the queue with exponential backoff.
3. Use idempotency keys to avoid duplicate writes.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Actions can be queued offline without data loss.
- Queued items sync automatically once connectivity returns.
